theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (x : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → DifferentiableAt ℝ η x → exteriorDerivative (fun y => g y • η y) x = g x • exteriorDerivative η x + ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((fderiv ℝ g x).smulRight (η x))
